stages.title: Freeze exact activation record
stages.entry: User-approved source/stages/budget/storage/window/contacts; validated disabled source and offline rule-parser results
stages.exit: Archive current Git pins, config fields, workload/PVC identities and no-prune policy; prepare narrow metadata-only monitoring ownership
stages.rollback_or_hold: No mutation; retain baseline; hold if inputs incomplete

stages.title: Enable approved UWM consumer only
stages.entry: Approved supported merged config and resource/storage proposal; unrelated-user-project impact reviewed
stages.exit: Only approved managed UWM components healthy, resource/storage fit and selected namespace discovery verified; no broker change
stages.rollback_or_hold: Hold new stages; targeted merge to prior enablement only if exclusive ownership and data/consumer protection permit; never broad ConfigMap delete

stages.title: Create JMX ConfigMap and metrics-only broker change
stages.entry: All3dual-role brokers healthy/fullISR/metadata quorum from approved observable source; retention/replay margin and planned write interruption accepted
stages.exit: Observe operator-driven serial reconciliation, at most1unavailable broker/controller, restored ISR/quorum and target state; do not force rolling or weaken ISR
stages.rollback_or_hold: Prefer hold/repair of exact metrics delta after inspecting reconciliation; reversal can cause another roll; no Pod/PVC delete or downgrade

stages.title: Enable exact broker scrape, rules still held
stages.entry: Approved PodMonitor ownership/selection/9404 effective policy; no arbitrary cross-namespace allowance
stages.exit: 3/3expected broker targets up, all5gauge families/labels present, scrape interval/timeout and current cardinality observed
stages.rollback_or_hold: Stop own scrape through reviewed selector disable/update if needed; keep JMX ConfigMap while referenced; no broker reversal solely for a scrape fault

stages.title: Receiver/routing gate before any live rules
stages.entry: Known approved existing routing/contact and owner disposition; if a new KaaS route is needed, its exact merged/pinned change is approved before rules
stages.exit: Routing disposition/config accepted and unrelated routes preserved. Actual future rules may generate natural notifications; safe test signal is separately held
stages.rollback_or_hold: If routing/recipient is unknown, hold A5/A6 and stop after scrape-only. Any route correction restores only owned fragment; no shared receiver deletion

stages.title: Enable reviewed broker rules and queries
stages.entry: A4 routing disposition accepted, including natural notifications; PromQL/rule fixtures passed and evaluator/target data verified
stages.exit: Rules reconcile/evaluate without errors; required absent-series handling explicit; no test alert or fault injected
stages.rollback_or_hold: Targeted group/route hold under approved owner workflow; source deletion with no-prune does not stop live rule evaluation

stages.title: Optional sink infrastructure rules
stages.entry: A4 routing accepted; evaluator can see platform kubelet/kube-state series and existing sink labels/free-space floor verified
stages.exit: Rule health and missing-series handling observed, no signal overload, no claim of unimplemented durableACK/error metrics
stages.rollback_or_hold: Restore only own changed rule group or disable via approved targeted update; no sink restart or evidence cleanup

stages.title: Closeout and owner handoff
stages.entry: Previous selected stages have dispositions and all4clientJobs remain suspended
stages.exit: Read-only preservation, actual resource/target/rule/timing/custody receipts; exact known gaps and storage holds recorded
stages.rollback_or_hold: Leave healthy resources in place; rollback only by stage-specific reviewed authority; no automatic prune or cleanup

ownership.Kafka_metrics_change: Existing kaas-demo-kafka Application/source; current Kafka AppProject remains Kafka-kinds only
ownership.Kafka_namespace_new_monitors: Proposed distinct observability Project/Application allows only ConfigMap/PodMonitor/PrometheusRule into kaas-kafka, no Kafka kinds
ownership.Evidence_namespace_rules: Proposed distinct observability Project/Application allows only PrometheusRule into kaas-demo; no Job/Deployment/PVC/Secret
ownership.UWM_cluster_monitoring_config: Authorized platform owner supported Git/configuration workflow; no access via tenant Projects
ownership.RBAC: Inspect effective existing rights at activation; only separately reviewed missing namespace/kind non-delete grants, no blanket wildcard/cluster-admin promotion

time_policy.timeout_behavior: Stop further C0-initiated promotions; preserve/inspect operator state; not an automatic kill/instant reconciliation stop or recovery PASS

non_goals: Direct cluster actions under current planning request
